trust_decision.summary: Directory entry names (from disk or embedded dir) and the request URI path are untrusted and must be HTML-escaped / percent-encoded before being spliced into the ServeDir HtmlFileList page; decided (not done) in generate_directory_html.

landing_point.why: Summary names ServeDir HTML directory listing with file names and URI path; generate_directory_html is the only HTML builder for it and uses raw format!.

fix_sites.entry_point: ServeDir::new / ServeDir::new_embedded with DirectoryServeMode::HtmlFileList, called as a service (HTTP GET on a directory)
fix_sites.module_kind: core renderer (security fix: rewritten with html! macros + Uri::path_mut, moved to open_file_html.rs, fix.diff:674-750)

fix_sites.entry_point: same (maybe_serve_directory HtmlFileList arm, entry collection moved to serve_html_listing fix.diff:527-588)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No second listing implementation: the only hand-built HTML with interpolation outside examples is open_file.rs:758-823; other HTML pages (rama-cli httptest/fp, src/cli/service/ip.rs) already use the html! macros.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak: a solver could argue the URI path in <title>/<h1>/breadcrumb is not 'stored' XSS (request-reflected, and HTTP parser may reject raw '<'/'"'), and fix only file names; the summary explicitly names the URI path, so this is unlikely to hold.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Listing links must stay navigable: hrefs for names containing '&', ''', spaces or non-ASCII must still resolve (percent-encode the href, HTML-escape the attribute), breadcrumb links must keep working, and entries must not be dropped or filtered; the fix's test expects specific href forms like href="/a&b.txt".

O6_input_shapes: file name in link text (HTML text context)
file name in href attribute (attribute + URI context)
URI path segments in breadcrumb href and label
filesystem source vs embedded include_dir source (both feed the same renderer)

O7_producer.where: Entries are produced inline by tokio::fs::read_dir / include_dir in the same function (rama-http/src/service/fs/serve_dir/open_file.rs:527-560) and passed straight to the renderer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a hand-built HTML 404/not-found body echoing the requested path for FileNotFound/InvalidFilename
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same OpenFileOutput dispatch already produces an Html body next to it; a maintainer adding a friendly 404 page would reuse format! like the original listing did.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a static/HTML landing page in the CLI fs service that lists the content path or redirect target via format!
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI fs service already wraps an Html service type (ServeStaticHtml) alongside ServeDir; second package from the landing point.

O9_family: CWE-116/CWE-79 output encoding (HTML injection in generated directory listing)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo (workspace; rama-http with feature html for the fixed code)
O10_build.project_tests: rama-http/src/service/fs/serve_dir/tests.rs (serve_directory_as_file_tree at line ~593 using test-files), unit tests at open_file.rs bottom; cargo test -p rama-http
